scope: Root and grouped related aggregates on two fixed SQLite fixtures. Checks count complete output rows, not independent use cases. No speed ranking.
limitations: Shared integers stay in the safe number range; exact large sums, storage guards and collations are tested independently.
The two-collection observation compares independent path totals with the explicitly computed cross-product of the two LEFT JOIN domains. It is scoped to the pinned SQLite release and these fixtures.
Related domain filters are tested against the independent oracle only. They are not claimed to reproduce the Orange API.
Unexpected outcomes throw and write no success report. NULL/NaN/zero representation differences are recorded separately.

cases.name: root / count leaves
cases.orangeSql: select count("zchildren"."id") as "value" from "gp" "gp" LEFT JOIN "gc" "zchildren" ON ("gp"."id"="zchildren"."parentId")

cases.name: root / count nonnull
cases.orangeSql: select count("zchildren"."amount") as "value" from "gp" "gp" LEFT JOIN "gc" "zchildren" ON ("gp"."id"="zchildren"."parentId")

cases.name: root / sum leaves
cases.orangeSql: select COALESCE(sum("zchildren"."amount"), 0) as "value" from "gp" "gp" LEFT JOIN "gc" "zchildren" ON ("gp"."id"="zchildren"."parentId")

cases.name: root / average leaves
cases.orangeSql: select COALESCE(avg("zchildren"."score"), 0) as "value" from "gp" "gp" LEFT JOIN "gc" "zchildren" ON ("gp"."id"="zchildren"."parentId")

cases.name: root / min leaves
cases.orangeSql: select min("zchildren"."score") as "value" from "gp" "gp" LEFT JOIN "gc" "zchildren" ON ("gp"."id"="zchildren"."parentId")

cases.name: root / max leaves
cases.orangeSql: select max("zchildren"."score") as "value" from "gp" "gp" LEFT JOIN "gc" "zchildren" ON ("gp"."id"="zchildren"."parentId")

cases.name: root / two child collections with root count
cases.orangeSql: select count("gp"."id") as "roots",COALESCE(sum("zchildren"."amount"), 0) as "a",COALESCE(sum("zpayments"."amount"), 0) as "b" from "gp" "gp" LEFT JOIN "gc" "zchildren" ON ("gp"."id"="zchildren"."parentId") LEFT JOIN "gm" "zpayments" ON ("gp"."id"="zpayments"."parentId")
